chunks: And in the narration of al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad al-Jawharī
The cow is to be confined for twenty days.

key_terms.الْبَقَرَةَ: the cow referred to in the ruling
key_terms.الْجَوْهَرِيِّ: the nisbah of the narrator al-Jawharī

ai.seo_question: How long should a cow be confined according to this narration?
ai.summary: This report transmits a legal ruling concerning a cow, stating that it is to be restrained for twenty days. The narration is cited through al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad al-Jawharī and relates to jurisprudential rulings in the chapter on hunting and slaughtering.
